description: PVAnalytics is a Python library maintained by the pvlib community for checking and interpreting photovoltaic-system measurements. It includes quality checks for irradiance, weather, time spacing, gaps, stuck values and data shifts. Feature functions identify clipping, clear-sky periods, daytime, tracking or fixed orientation and shading; other tools estimate system characteristics and calculate metrics. Inputs are measured time series, and many functions return Boolean masks for filtering or labelling. Coverage is global and input-dependent, with temporal resolution inherited from the monitored system. Public source, pip installation and example documentation are free under MIT. A limitation is that individual checks do not establish complete measurement validity, and the README warns that module organisation may change as use cases evolve. The library can prepare calibration and validation inputs for photovoltaic and electricity-system simulations, complementary to model-pypsa. Its repository links the archived software DOI. The package was not installed and no site measurements or quality-control results were obtained.
